claims.text: Corinthia Rome occupies a grand palazzo on Piazza del Parlamento, in Rome's historic heart.

findings.quote: In Rome’s historic heart, Corinthia Rome opens the doors of a grand palazzo on Piazza del Parlamento.

claims.text: The hotel is in the historic Campo Marzio district.

findings.quote: Located on Piazza del Parlamento in the heart of the historic Campo Marzio district

claims.text: The hotel is just moments from the Pantheon, the Trevi Fountain and the Spanish Steps.

findings.quote: just moments from the Pantheon, Trevi Fountain and Spanish Steps

claims.text: The 1920s building served as the offices of the Bank of Italy until 1961.

findings.quote: Until 1961, the 1920s building served as the offices of the Bank of Italy.

claims.text: Restoration of the building uncovered mosaics, stuccoes, cornices, painted ceilings and marble details.

findings.quote: The project uncovered exquisite mosaics, stuccoes, cornices, painted ceilings, and marble details.

claims.text: The Corinthia Spa sits in the bank's former historic vault and is inspired by the ritual of Roman bathing.

findings.quote: Once the bank’s historic vault, the space now protects something far more precious
Inspired by the ritual of Roman bathing, the Corinthia Spa unfolds as an intimate subterranean retreat

claims.text: The spa has a tepidarium, a calidarium and a frigidarium.

findings.quote: There’s a tepidarium, calidarium, and frigidarium

claims.text: Rooms have high ceilings and large windows, with views of the city's rooftops or the quiet inner courtyard.

findings.quote: Soffitti alti e grandi finestre lasciano entrare la luce naturale, con viste sui tetti della città o sul tranquillo cortile interno.

claims.text: Rooms have marble bathrooms, and all rooms include books on art, culture and history.

findings.quote: The 60 rooms have some common denominators: lots of space, plenty of light, and marble bathrooms.
All rooms include Dyson hairdryers, a steamer to freshen clothes, a minibar, and lots of books on art, culture, and history

claims.text: From the Arte Suite, guests can see the Vatican.

findings.quote: From the Arte Suite, you can see the Vatican

claims.text: Dining at the hotel is curated by chef Carlo Cracco, in his Roman debut.

findings.quote: curated by Italy’s celebrated chef Carlo Cracco in his Roman debut

claims.text: Piazzetta, at the heart of the palazzo, is a lively open-kitchen and garden retreat.

findings.quote: Piazzetta is the heart of the palazzo. A lively open-kitchen and garden retreat

claims.text: In the spa, a path leads from two baths at different temperatures to a hammam, a sauna, an ice fountain and beds of heated black stones.

findings.quote: a path leads from two baths at different temperatures to a hammam, sauna, ice fountain, and then beds of heated black stones

claims.text: The Sala del Consiglio on the piano nobile has frescoes by Giulio Bargellini on the theme of prosperity.

findings.quote: The centerpiece is the Sala del Consiglio on the piano nobile, with frescoes by Giulio Bargellini on the theme of prosperity.

claims.text: The Theodoli Heritage Suite uses the Sala del Consiglio, where the bank's board of directors met, as its living room.

findings.quote: the Theodoli Heritage Suite, on the first floor, incorporates the Sala de Consiglio, where the bank’s board of directors would meet, as its living room

claims.text: The Chigi Suite opens onto a large panoramic rooftop terrace.

findings.quote: la Chigi Suite si apre su un’ampia terrazza panoramica sul tetto

claims.text: The hotel faces Palazzo Montecitorio, the seat of the Italian parliament, near Via del Corso.

findings.quote: facing the Palazzo Montecitorio, the seat of the Italian parliament, and near the Via del Corso

claims.text: The building is listed, which presents some accessibility challenges in public areas; four guest rooms are designed for guests with mobility, hearing or visual impairments.

findings.quote: Every effort has been made to make public areas accessible, though the listed nature of the building presents some challenges.
There are four guestrooms specifically designed for those with mobility, hearing, or visual impairments.

claims.text: The spa is an underground retreat in the former bank vault, beneath the palazzo.

findings.quote: beneath the palazzo, a subterranean spa brings restoration and renewal
Once the bank’s historic vault, the space now protects something far more precious

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
